Emma —

Thanks for the SOW and DPA. I've run this by our solutions and legal leads; attached are Redwood's redlines for the SOW and a comment PDF for the DPA. High-level notes below so procurement can see the tradeoffs up front:  

- Timeline: We can commit an integration engineer for a 6-week engagement starting June 15, with a week of overlap for knowledge transfer. I'll confirm the resource name once the internal allocation is finalized.
- Data residency / retention: We propose storing telemetry in the US region (us-west-2) by default. If AxonWorks requires EU residency we will need a separate routing policy and may trigger a Dedicated capacity quote.
- DPA: Our legal asked to keep liability cap tied to 3x fees paid in the prior 12 months; we marked a proposed compromise in the DPA redline. We also included SOC 2 + KMS requirements under Security Controls.
- IP / Deliverables: SOW retains that Redwood will grant AxonWorks a license to the integration deliverables; any joint IP will be handled via an addendum.

Next steps: Can AxonWorks review the redlines and tell us which items are non-starters? If acceptable, we suggest DocuSign for signatures and then a kickoff week beginning June 15.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_redline_20260527.docx, Redwood_DPA_comments_20260527.pdf

Thanks —

Priya / Jonas —

I reviewed AxonWorks' DPA and put redlines in the attached PDF. A few items to call out for procurement:

1) Liability cap: We proposed 3x fees as a starting point; if AxonWorks requests a higher cap we should quantify risk and consider insurance-backed options.
2) Data processing: Add explicit language that Redwood will process telemetry as a subprocessor and that AxonWorks remains the controller of its customer data.
3) Audit rights: Limit audit frequency to once per 12 months with reasonable notice and scope.
4) Security annex: Insert references to our SOC 2 Type II report and KMS controls; Marissa suggested the following short clause to include in DPA Section 4: "Provider maintains SOC 2 Type II and leverages customer-specific encryption keys via KMS where requested; logs retained for 90 days by default unless otherwise agreed."

Thanks for the quick turnaround and redlines. A few counterpoints from AxonWorks legal:

- We can accept the 90-day default log retention for telemetry, but need explicit handling for deletion requests under CCPA/DPER where applicable — propose a separate SOW schedule describing those flows.
- Liability cap: procurement is pushing for a commercial cap tied to net damages only (no indirects). We can agree to 3x fees but would prefer explicit carve-outs for willful misconduct.
- Warranty: we will not accept a broad performance warranty; we can agree to "best efforts" for the integration deliverables with specific acceptance tests in the SOW.

I've attached a revised DPA with our comments (AxonWorks_DPA_revised_20260528.docx). I also added an inline SOW comment asking for the acceptance criteria for delivery milestones.

If Redwood is comfortable with a mutual acceptance test and a 3x fees cap (with the willful misconduct carve-out), AxonWorks can proceed to DocuSign. We've prepared an envelope for signatures: https://app.docusign.com/AXW-Envelope-123456

Attachments: AxonWorks_DPA_revised_20260528.docx

Appreciate the clear schedule and the DocuSign link. We're aligned on most items. Quick summary and final proposals so procurement can close this week:

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- Today: Legal finalize DPA redlines (both parties)
- Tue 6/1: Sign DPA via DocuSign
- Mon 6/14: Resource allocation finalized (engineer assigned)
- Mon 6/15: Kickoff week begins; 6-week engagement starts

Open negotiation points we propose as final compromises:
- Liability cap: Redwood accepts 3x fees paid in prior 12 months. AxonWorks may keep carve-out language for willful misconduct; Redwood requests mutual carve-outs (i.e., both parties retain rights for willful misconduct).
- Warranty & acceptance: Redwood will provide acceptance tests in SOW Milestones and deliver "best efforts" for integration performance; acceptance gates to be sign-off by both engineering leads.
- Data residency: Default is US (us-west-2). If AxonWorks requires EU-only residency, we will provide a Dedicated capacity quote and list any incremental lead times/costs in the SOW Schedule.

If you confirm these three points, I'll request Marissa to finalize the DPA language and then we can execute through DocuSign. Let me know if procurement needs a PO number on the DocuSign envelope.
